## 🎯 Problem

A clear and concise description of what problem this feature would solve.
Ex: "I'm always frustrated when [...]"

## 💡 Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered

What other solutions have you considered? Why didn't they work?

## 👥 User Stories

Who would benefit from this feature, and how?

- **As a** [student/admin/teacher]
- **I want to** [action]
- **So that** [benefit]

## 📋 Acceptance Criteria

What would define "done" for this feature?

- [ ] Criteria 1
- [ ] Criteria 2
- [ ] Criteria 3

## 🎨 Mockups / Wireframes (Optional)

If applicable, add mockups, wireframes, or sketches to illustrate your idea.

```
[Add image or ASCII wireframe here]
```

## 🔧 Technical Considerations

- **API changes:** [Which endpoints affected?]
- **Database changes:** [New tables/columns?]
- **UI changes:** [New pages/components?]
- **Performance impact:** [Bundle size, query load, etc.]
- **Backward compatibility:** [Breaking changes?]

## 🎯 Priority

- [ ] **Must have** (blocks learning workflow)
- [ ] **Should have** (significant impact)
- [ ] **Nice to have** (quality of life)
- [ ] **Future** (long-term roadmap)

## 🌟 Inspiration

- **Similar features in other apps:** [e.g., Duolingo's streak freeze]
- **User research:** [Link to user feedback / interviews]
- **Bangladesh education context:** [Why this is needed in BD]

## 💼 Effort Estimate

Your guess at implementation effort:

- [ ] **Small** (< 1 day)
- [ ] **Medium** (1-3 days)
- [ ] **Large** (1 week)
- [ ] **Epic** (> 1 week, needs design)

## 📎 Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or examples about the feature request here.
